required.description: Locate a stash of loose, fist-sized rocks — stand near a workable stone deposit without using it.

optional_pool.description: Survive a set number of in-game days at this stage.
Successfully forage and eat from 3 different biomes/food sources.
Survive a predator encounter using tree-climbing to escape, without fighting back.
Cross a stretch of open grassland using only tree-to-tree movement.
Drink from at least 3 distinct natural water sources across your range.

milestone.description: At the stone deposit, strike a rock against another rock to produce a sharp flake.
